Finding chartered school with fewest K-12 students and its administrator email:

QUERY: SELECT CDSCode, `School Name`, `Enrollment (K-12)`, `Charter School (Y/N)` FROM frpm WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 5

QUERY: SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`School Name`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, sc.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm f JOIN schools sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1
